language.name: English
page.title: Service Overview
page.subtitle: Services registered on {hostCount} hosts; localhost is listed first, cross-host links use registered overlay addresses.
nav.search: Filter by name, tag or port
host.crossHostUnreachableNote: No overlay address is registered for this host; cross-host access is unavailable.
host.wslNote: WSL2: Windows reaches these ports through WSL localhost forwarding. Cross-host access requires an overlay client registered for this distro; without one, the distro is reachable only on this machine.
empty.noServices: No enabled service with a catalog entry on this host.
empty.noResults: No service matches the current filter.
reason.localOnly: Only reachable on the host itself; this page is open from another machine.
reason.loopbackOnly: The service binds to loopback on its host.
reason.noTailscale: No Tailscale address is registered for this host.
reason.needsTailscale: Requires Tailscale to be online on the client.
reason.noMagicDns: No MagicDNS name is registered; access uses the Tailscale IP.
reason.needsOverlay: Requires a peer on the {network} network.
reason.noOverlay: No overlay address is registered for this host; cross-host access is unavailable.
reason.wslWindows: Requires WSL localhost forwarding on Windows (default on).
note.homepage: Static page generated from the port registry; the service list has no second source.
note.opencode2api: The API listens on 1101; this card links the WebUI on 1102.
note.cliproxyapi: CLI proxy with an offline management panel.
note.omniroute: Unified LLM gateway with dashboard; the first-start bootstrap token is in the journal.
note.our-free-model-standalone: Upstream requires a loopback bind, so it is reachable only on its host.
note.agent2api: API and management panel share one port.
note.acb: AgentChatBridge console; the dsh endpoint stays loopback-only and is not listed.
note.alist: File listing; the optional S3 listener is not listed.
note.sub-store: Subscription panel behind Basic Auth; the JSON API on 24500 is not listed.
